'''Glideflip''' is a [[Water]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Stoodbeak]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Having tried so many jobs and hobbies, Glideflip is now a job-hunting expert who occasionally offers guidance to rookie Tatari. That temper, however, hasn't mellowed one bit. Even in the sweltering summer, Glideflip's rage can still whip up a mini-blizzard."

Glideflip is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "A fearsome penguin tyrant capable of whipping up blizzards in rage and freezing treaded earth for hours."
